subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Timid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"timid"** means lacking in courage or confidence; easily frightened. (डरपोक)

 
 
• **Example: **The** timid **child hid behind his mother when strangers approached.
 
 
 
• **"Audacious" **refers to showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; very bold and daring. (साहसी)
 
 
• **Example: **The **audacious** adventurer climbed the treacherous mountain without any fear.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'timid' **is **'audacious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Blunt **(मुँहफट): Being straightforward and unceremoniously forthright.

 
 
• **Example:** His blunt comments often upset people, but they appreciated his honesty.
 
 
 
• **Resolute **(दृढ़): Admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.
 
 
• **Example: **She remained resolute in her decision despite the opposition.
 
 
 
• **Assertive** (आत्मविश्वासी): Having or showing a confident and forceful personality.
 
 
• **Example:** Being assertive in meetings can help you get your ideas heard.
 
 

45:Tb5a,

The correct answer is: Option 3.<
